name: The Legend of Heroes
overview: In the late Southern Song Dynasty, as the Jin forces invaded, the Guo and Yang families faced tragedy. Taoist Qiu Chuji and the Seven Freaks of Jiangnan bet to train their descendants in martial arts. Guo Jing and Yang Kang, growing up under different circumstances, face various challenges. Guo Jing and Huang Rong develop a relationship amid turmoil, while Yang Kang's actions affect those around him.

seasons.name: Hot Blooded
seasons.overview: In the late Song Dynasty, the Yang and Guo families made a pledge that their future children will become sworn siblings or marry if of different genders. However, before they could fulfill their pact, both families were tragically killed by the invading Jin army. Orphaned by the war, Guo Jing (Ci Sha) and Yang Kang (Wang Hong Yi) were raised by different martial arts masters with the goal of avenging their families' deaths. While Guo Jing follows the path of honor, Yang Kang betrays his family by siding with the Jin army. Accompanied by the adventurous Huang Rong (Bao Shang En), Guo Jing eventually encounters Yang Kang, but their once-promised brotherhood has turned into hate.  Based on the novel “The Legend of the Condor Heroes” by Jin Yong.

seasons.name: Duel on Mount Hua: Nine Yin True Sutra
seasons.overview: Mei Ruohua, a scion of a seafaring dynasty, loses everything to her family's massacre, fueling her lifelong quest for vengeance. By fate, she becomes a disciple of Taohua Island, renaming herself Mei Chaofeng. Bound to her senior, Chen Xuanfeng, by forbidden love. Obsessed with mastering peerless martial arts for revenge, Mei Chaofeng mistakenly believes her master Huang Yaoshi hoards the Nine Yin Manual and refuses to teach its secrets. Bound by love and oath, the pair steals the manual and flees the island. They master the Nine Yin White Bone Claw, earning infamy as the Black Wind Twin Evils. Yet their love cannot last.

seasons.name: Duel on Mount Hua: Eastern Heretic and Western Venom
seasons.overview: Huang Yaoshi and Ouyang Feng, two eccentric newcomers to the martial world. One drifts like an untethered immortal, the other gleeful as a child. Neither friend nor foe, neither wholly righteous nor wicked, they shatter the martial world's order with their own rules, unleashing a storm of unpredictable chaos.

seasons.name: Duel on Mount Hua: Southern Emperor and Northern Beggar
seasons.overview: The crown prince of Dali, Duan Zhixing, escapes from an arranged royal marriage and befriends Hong Qi, a disciple of the Beggars' Sect. Due to a mix-up, a woman named Yihuo mistakes Hong Qi as her betrothed, turning a misunderstanding into a fateful connection. By a twist of fate, Hong Qi masters powerful martial arts and rises to become the leader of the Beggars' Sect, but an old grudge from their fathers' generation sparks a rift between Hong Qi and Duan Zhixing.

seasons.name: Duel on Mount Hua: The Five
seasons.overview: Set in a reimagined martial arts world, this tale follows the legacy of the Five Greats — legendary figures whose untold pasts shaped the martial world. As hidden stories emerge and new rivalries ignite, a fresh generation of heroes rises to carry forward the spirit of chivalry, honor, and adventure.
